- **A)** Your **default address** on your account, and/or
- **B)** The shipping address for a **specific pending order** (share the order ID, if you have it)

Yes—I can do that. To avoid typing, I just need to know **which pending order** already has the address you want to use.

Please tell me the **order ID** (e.g., `#W2166301`) of the pending order that contains the correct address.  

Once you share that, I will:
1) set that same address as your **default account address**, and  
2) update the **shipping address for all your currently pending orders**.
